picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the Air Force flew an AI agent in autonomous control of an F-16, a major real-world milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat and a signal of how fast military AI autonomy is advancing.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab detailed DOE's American Science Cloud, a federated national infrastructure unifying data, models, and HPC resources under the Genesis Mission — a foundational policy move that will shape how U.S. national labs do AI research for years.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health teamed with top-tier VCs Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital to launch an AI accelerator embedded directly in a live clinical environment, a novel model for turning healthcare AI research into deployed tools.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven revival of UK aerospace, energy, and defence manufacturing — a national industrial strategy summit with real policy weight.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge and UC Santa Barbara researchers proved certain problems are fundamentally unlearnable by any AI system regardless of data, a rare theoretical result that reframes what we should expect AI can ever achieve.
picks.title: Testing the limits of what’s possible (and what isn’t) with AI

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center, a significant international academia-industry partnership expanding AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies convened an international consensus study on how AI is lowering barriers to biological threats, directly shaping forthcoming biosecurity policy and countermeasure strategy.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies

picks.editorial_note: A major alumnus philanthropic commitment is funding Georgia Tech's new Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, a substantial capital investment aimed at using AI to predict and treat disease.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: A $2.7 million ARPA-E grant will let Iowa State and Ames Lab use machine learning to accelerate discovery of stronger, more sustainable magnet materials, a concrete federal bet on AI-driven materials science.
picks.title: AI-powered hunt for stronger magnets earns Iowa State and Ames Lab $2.7 million grant

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Toyota Research Institute's SceneSmith uses AI agents to generate diverse 3D training environments for robots, addressing one of robotics' biggest bottlenecks — realistic, varied training data.
picks.title: AI agents create virtual playgrounds to help robots get crucial training data
